args.sql:
SELECT 
    a.artregistry AS registry_number,
    a.artname AS artifact_name,
    a.mattype AS material_type,
    sd.lightsensitivity,
    CASE 
        WHEN sd.lightsensitivity = 'High' AND MAX(lrr.lightlux) > 50 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        WHEN sd.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' AND MAX(lrr.lightlux) > 200 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        ELSE 'Within Limits'
    END AS current_status
FROM artifactscore a
JOIN sensitivitydata sd ON a.artregistry = sd.artref
JOIN conditionassessments ca ON a.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
JOIN lightreadrefobserved = lrr.lightradregistry
WHERE sd.lightsensitivity IN ('High', 'Medium')
GROUP BY a.artregistry, a.artname, a.mattype, sd.lightsensitivity
ORDER BY a.artregistry;

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry AS registry_number,
        a.artname AS artifact_name,
        a.mattype AS material_type,
        sd.lightsensitivity,
        CASE 
            WHEN sd.lightsensitivity = 'High' AND MAX(lrr.lightlux) > 50 THEN 'Over Exposure'
            WHEN sd.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' AND MAX(lrr.lightlux) > 200 THEN 'Over Exposure'
            ELSE 'Within Limits'
        END AS current_status
    FROM artifactscore a
    JOIN sensitivitydata sd ON a.artregistry = sd.artref
    JOIN conditionassessments ca ON a.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
    JOIN lightandradiationreadings lrr ON ca.lightreadrefobserved = lrr.lightradregistry
    WHERE sd.lightsensitivity IN ('High', 'Medium')
    GROUP BY a.artregistry, a.artname, a.mattype, sd.lightsensitivity
) sub;

SELECT current_status, COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT 
        a.artregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN sd.lightsensitivity = 'High' AND MAX(lrr.lightlux) > 50 THEN 'Over Exposure'
            WHEN sd.lightsensitivity = 'Medium' AND MAX(lrr.lightlux) > 200 THEN 'Over Exposure'
            ELSE 'Within Limits'
        END AS current_status
    FROM artifactscore a
    JOIN sensitivitydata sd ON a.artregistry = sd.artref
    JOIN conditionassessments ca ON a.artregistry = ca.artrefexamined
    JOIN lightandradiationreadings lrr ON ca.lightreadrefobserved = lrr.lightradregistry
    WHERE sd.lightsensitivity IN ('High', 'Medium')
    GROUP BY a.artregistry, sd.lightsensitivity
) sub
GROUP BY current_status;
